title: ClearPath Managed IT Services Schedule A: Seat Rate Card, Terms and Seat Minimums
content:
This schedule sets, for every tier of ClearPath Managed IT Services, the list monthly fee per seat, the term lengths a tier may be signed or renewed for, the discount each signed term length earns off the list fee, and the seat minimums.

## A.1 Definitions

- **List monthly fee per seat**: the list monthly fee per seat in USD for a new agreement or a tier change, before any term discount.
- **Allowed terms**: the contract term lengths, in months, the tier may be signed or renewed for.
- **Term discount**: the discount, in percent, off the list monthly fee per seat by signed term length. A term length the tier does not offer has no entry.
- **Minimum seats**: the minimum seats that may be contracted at signing or after a tier change.
- **Minimum seat commitment percentage**: the minimum monthly billed seats during a term, as a percent of the contracted seats; the floor is the contracted seats times that percentage divided by 100, rounded up to a whole seat.

## A.2 Rate card

| Tier (rank) | List fee per seat (USD) | Allowed terms (months) | Term discount by term | Minimum seats | Minimum seat commitment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| ClearPath Monitor (1) | 38.50 | 12, 24, 36 | 12 months: 0 percent; 24 months: 0 percent; 36 months: 0 percent | 5 | 80 percent |
| ClearPath Essentials (2) | 89.00 | 12, 24, 36 | 12 months: 0 percent; 24 months: 2 percent; 36 months: 4 percent | 10 | 85 percent |
| ClearPath Standard (3) | 124.00 | 12, 24, 36 | 12 months: 0 percent; 24 months: 2 percent; 36 months: 4 percent | 10 | 85 percent |
| ClearPath Professional (4) | 149.00 | 12, 24, 36 | 12 months: 0 percent; 24 months: 3 percent; 36 months: 5 percent | 15 | 90 percent |
| ClearPath Premier (5) | 189.00 | 24, 36, 60 | 24 months: 3 percent; 36 months: 5 percent; 60 months: 7.5 percent | 25 | 90 percent |
| ClearPath Enterprise (6) | 236.00 | 36, 60 | 36 months: 5 percent; 60 months: 7.5 percent | 75 | 90 percent |

Tiers are ranked from ClearPath Monitor (rank 1, lowest) to ClearPath Enterprise (rank 6, highest).

## A.3 Entry requirements

| Tier | Minimum seats at entry | Onboarding assessment required | Active Sentinel Managed Security subscription required |
|---|---|---|---|
| ClearPath Monitor | 5 | Yes | No |
| ClearPath Essentials | 10 | Yes | No |
| ClearPath Standard | 10 | Yes | No |
| ClearPath Professional | 15 | Yes | No |
| ClearPath Premier | 25 | Yes | Yes |
| ClearPath Enterprise | 75 | Yes | Yes |

## A.4 Reading the schedule (hypothetical figures)

- A hypothetical agreement of 20 contracted seats on a tier whose minimum seat commitment is 85 percent has a floor of 20 times 85 divided by 100, that is 17 seats. At 90 percent, 25 contracted seats give 22.5, rounded up to a floor of 23 seats.
- The list fee per seat of ClearPath Professional reduced by its 36-month discount of 5 percent is 149.00 times 0.95, that is 141.55.
- ClearPath Enterprise has no 12-month or 24-month entry: it is not signed or renewed for those lengths.
